speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You are early for a man who is not cast. I am for Shoreditch. The lute can wait one title.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it with me, Phillips. Then I am for the desk.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Barnardo and Fiammetta. Black-letter, and no man's name under it. Raye says two lovers and a jealous old husband, out of Boccaccio or somebody's Boccaccio.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two lovers. I have two of my own at home, in a red-tied bundle, and the vault of their deaths still to write.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The Admiral's tireman has been buying Italian sleeves. Henslowe has smelt Italy, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him go first. The road's wide.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Wide enough. You have the title. I am for Shoreditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I will put the title on the tables with the Rose's bills. I am for the desk.
